Application deadline for Hamlyn Winter School on Surgical Imaging and Vision

The Hamlyn Winter School on Surgical Imaging and Vision is a week long course, held this year Nov. 30-Dec. 4, 2026. Participants should have a science or medical degree and typically be at a master, doctoral or postdoctoral level.
